about: Test audio for the examples: public domain or CC0 only, from Wikimedia Commons. Licence and author as stated on each file page (checked 2026-10-28). Audio files are never committed (cache/audio is git-ignored); tools/fetch_audio.py downloads them and checks SHA-256.
